title: 第1章 洪荒时代第2章 先救人为好
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
飞花市，鼎丰公司项目主管的办公室。
“你想辞职？童元安，你可要想清楚了，咱们这可是全国排名前五十的大公司，发展前景大好。”
施传良看着手中的辞职信，一时愣住了。
在他面前站着的是一个年轻的小伙子，这可是他亲手提拔起来的好苗子。
他还想试着说服对方留下，但话到了嘴边又咽了回去。
对于童元安的性格，施传良非常熟悉，看到那坚定的眼神就知道事情没那么简单了。
“唉！”
施传良叹了口气。
其实对于童元安做出的选择，并不感到太意外。
两天前，在公司的群里有一篇名为《年度优秀员工名单》的通知，表扬了一位连续加班一个月的同事，号召大家学习这种精神。
大多数人都点了赞，但唯独童元安表达了强烈不满，表示为了一个小奖杯和一点奖金牺牲个人健康不值得鼓励。
这件事在网上引发了不小的风波，让不少人议论纷纷，甚至影响到了企业的形象。
上午在高层开会时，总经理还特别提到此事，要求妥善处理。
大家都知道，“处理”
的意思就是要童元安站出来澄清并道歉，来挽救公司的声誉。
不过谁都没想到他会主动请辞。
要知道，即使被开除也能得到一笔可观的补偿金，而自己辞职则一无所有。
在这个世界上，恐怕没有人会拒绝这样的好处吧。
然而正因为施传良对这个小伙子足够了解，他知道后者宁愿放弃也不愿意违背内心的准则去低头。
“如果将来有任何难处，记得联系我。”

施传良无奈地拿起笔，在文件上签了名字。
他对童元安一直有着极高的评价，不论是品格还是能力都是无可挑剔的。
但是作为一名经理，面对来自更高层的压力实在是无能为力，除非童元安肯妥协否则别无他法。
“谢谢您的理解和支持。”
童元安心平气顺地接过已经签署过的文件朝人事部门走去。
“咦，这不是咱公司的红人嘛，咋不去搞公关宣传却到我这里来了呢？”
人力资源部的负责人翘着腿打趣地说了一句，早上会议他也参与其中，在他眼里此刻童元安唯有配合公司才有一条出路。
“这是我的离职申请，请各位领导尽快批准以免耽误了我的假期计划！”
扔下这句话后便头也不回地离开了房间，只剩下满脸困惑不解的人事长官以及背后一片惊讶的目光。
这家伙莫非真的头脑不清楚吗？
在这座竞争激烈的都市中轻易放弃了如此宝贵的机会实在让人费解！
更别说还得意洋洋地说什么不误节日安排……
不到半天时间，所有的手续就已经办好，毕竟省下了可能要给的小职员遣散费令决策者相当高兴。
拿着最后整理好的物品箱回到简陋租来的住处——此地乃花城着名的贫民窟之一，狭窄潮湿的空间夹杂在公共卫生间旁，鱼龙混杂极为混乱不堪。
那么，童元安究竟是不是急需用钱呢？
的确缺，而且是极其缺乏！
作为出身于普通农村的孩子，能够立足于此完全是靠着梦想与努力奋斗。
content_en:
Feihua City, the office of the project manager of Dingfeng Company.
"Do you want to resign? Tong Yuan'an, you have to think clearly. We are one of the top 50 companies in the country and have great development prospects."
Shi Chuanliang looked at the resignation letter in his hand and was stunned for a moment.
Standing in front of him was a young man, a good young man whom he had raised with his own hands.
He also wanted to try to persuade the other party to stay, but he swallowed the words as soon as they reached his lips.
Shi Chuanliang was very familiar with Tong Yuanan's character, and when he saw the firm look in his eyes, he knew that things were not that simple.
"Alas!"
Shi Chuanliang sighed.
In fact, I am not too surprised by the choice Tong Yuanan made.
Two days ago, there was a notice in the company's group chat titled "List of Outstanding Employees of the Year", praising a colleague who had worked overtime for a month and calling on everyone to learn from this spirit.
Most people liked it, but only Tong Yuanan expressed strong dissatisfaction, saying that sacrificing personal health for a small trophy and a little bonus is not worth encouraging.
This incident caused quite a stir on the Internet, caused many people to discuss it, and even affected the image of the company.
During the high-level meeting in the morning, the general manager also specifically mentioned this matter and asked for it to be handled properly.
As we all know, "processing"
The purpose is to ask Tong Yuanan to stand up and clarify and apologize to save the company's reputation.
But no one expected that he would take the initiative to resign.
You know, even if you are fired, you can get a considerable amount of compensation, but if you resign, you will get nothing.
In this world, I'm afraid no one would refuse such a benefit.
However, precisely because Shi Chuanliang knew this young man well enough, he knew that the latter would rather give up than bow his head against his inner principles.
"If you have any difficulties in the future, remember to contact me."
Shi Chuanliang reluctantly picked up the pen and signed the document.
He has always had a very high opinion of Tong Yuanan, both in terms of character and ability.
But as a manager, he is really powerless in the face of pressure from higher levels. Unless Tong Yuanan is willing to compromise, there is no other way.
"Thank you for your understanding and support."
Tong Yuan'an calmly took the signed documents and walked towards the personnel department.
"Hey, isn't this a celebrity in our company? Why didn't he do public relations and publicity instead of coming to my place?"
The person in charge of the human resources department crossed his legs and joked that he was also involved in the morning meeting. In his eyes, Tong Yuanan could only find a way out by cooperating with the company at this moment.
"This is my resignation application. Please approve it as soon as possible, so as not to delay my vacation plan!"
After saying these words, he left the room without looking back, leaving only the confused face of the HR officer and a surprised look behind him.
Is this guy really not clear-headed?
It is puzzling to give up such a precious opportunity so easily in this highly competitive city!
Not to mention proudly saying that they will not miss the holiday arrangements...
In less than half a day, all the procedures had been completed. After all, the decision-maker was very happy to have saved the possible severance pay for the small staff.
Taking the last packed belongings box, I returned to the simple rented accommodation - this place is one of the famous slums in Huacheng. The narrow and damp space is mixed next to the public toilet, and the mixture of fish and dragons is extremely chaotic.
So, does Tong Yuanan need money urgently?
It is indeed lacking, and it is extremely lacking!
As a child born in an ordinary rural area, being able to stand here is entirely dependent on dreams and hard work.
